headline: UMass Dartmouth football player killed, teammate injured in Providence stabbing
dek: An 18-year-old freshman died after a stabbing outside a Providence nightclub, while a teammate suffered injuries police described as non-life-threatening. A fellow UMass Dartmouth student was arrested and charged with murder.
body: An 18-year-old UMass Dartmouth football player was killed and a teammate was injured in a stabbing early Saturday in Providence, according to Providence police and university officials.

Police said the violence followed an altercation at Mezzo Lounge and continued into the parking lot of a Wendy’s on Charles Street around 12:30 a.m. Marvins Antoine suffered stab wounds to the chest and died at Rhode Island Hospital. Kensley Macean, 19, was taken to the hospital with wounds to his head, neck and left arm that police described as non-life-threatening.

A 19-year-old UMass Dartmouth student was arrested on campus and charged with murder, police said. Investigators used vehicle-camera information to identify the car connected to the suspect, and police said the suspect was not a member of the football team. The circumstances that led to the altercation remain under investigation.

UMass Dartmouth Chancellor Mark Fuller said the university has no reason to believe there is an ongoing threat to the campus community. The school said support resources are available as students, teammates and staff mourn Antoine and await more information from investigators.
author: NorthEast News Desk
sourceName: CBS Boston, citing Providence Police Department and UMass Dartmouth
